about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Spanish software developer from Seville, with hands-on experience building internal business software. I enjoy solving practical problems and exploring systems programming, compilers, developer tools, graphics, and game-engine development. I'm currently looking for a software development role, preferably remote, where I can contribute to a team and keep growing through real engineering work.

items.name: Nebula
items.description: An experimental statically typed systems programming language with a compiler written in Java. The project explores parsing with ANTLR, semantic analysis, AST transformations, and LLVM-based native code generation. Its language features and compile-time memory-management analysis are still evolving, so it is an ongoing project rather than a production-ready compiler.

items.name: catlr
items.description: A C++17 command-line utility for exploring and reviewing codebases. It prints directory trees and file contents, supports include and exclude filters, reads .gitignore exclusion patterns, and can fall back to native implementations when optional external tools are unavailable. Built to make code review and project inspection less noisy.

items.name: Arcane
items.description: An experimental 3D engine built in Java with LWJGL. It includes engine components for rendering, meshes, materials, textures, scenes, input, and an entity-component architecture. The project explores real-time graphics and the structure of a game engine.

items.name: ENCASA App Suite
items.description: A suite of three internal applications developed to support incident tracking, supplier follow-up, and quality-control workflows. The tools integrated existing Excel-based company data and exposed selected information through a REST API. Source code is private because it relates to internal company systems.

items.name: PPE Distribution Automation
items.description: A local web application built to streamline the distribution of personal protective equipment (PPE). It generates PDF records and digitally signs them, reducing manual steps in an internal business process. Source code is private because it relates to company workflows.

items.name: CRIS
items.description: A Python tool that embeds files in PNG images and extracts them later. It uses RSA to protect the seed used to shuffle data placement. The project explores steganography and cryptography and is intended for learning, not production-grade security.

items.name: Minocraft
items.description: A Minecraft-inspired voxel project built in Java with LWJGL. It explores a block-based world, rendering, and game-loop mechanics.
